items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Clarence Profit wrote them things like [SINGS "STOMPIN AT THE SAVOY"]... Thelonious was patterning...kind of patterning his playing after Clarence Profit.

ctx.x:
Beautiful. That was a new sound. Then the
next time I heard a new sound was Clarence Profit. Clarence
Profit wrote them things like [SINGS "STOMPIN AT THE SAVOY"]
and [SINGS REFRAIN]...
